Name: MBMBaM - TravCan (Trash Can Tool Replacer)
Author: cowmastergaarad
Description:
What's up, TravNation? Don't have enough MBMBaM in your Stardew Valley? Do you need a supportive friend to tell you that your trash is NORMAL? Look no further than the TravCan! Whether you're a fan of the podcast or just want your trash can to say silly things, this is the mod for you!

This mod replaces the trash can(s) on the inventory menu. Comes with three new sound effects! In the config options, you can toggle whether the sprite are replaced, as well as whether the tool name is changed to "TravCan"!

Sound-bytes taken from this episode: [url=https://maximumfun.org/episodes/my-brother-my-brother-and-me/mbmbam-790-face-2-face-frogspotting/]MBMBaM 790[/url]

Manifest.Name: MBMBaM - TravCan
Manifest.Description: Your trash can tl is now a TravCan! (tmtmtm)
